description: Centrally maintained operation equivalence candidates for benchmark authoring. equivalent operations have substantially the same primary effect; alternatives can achieve a similar analytical effect but may differ in parameters, state, or propagation.

bar.selectCategory.note: bar.clickCategory uses the same runtime implementation. The other alternatives can isolate the same category but do not necessarily preserve selection-to-filter propagation.

heatmap.selectSubmatrix.note: All can identify the same x/y region, but highlight changes emphasis, filter removes other cells, and updateSelection uses a generic selection payload.

line.selectSeries.note: These operations can isolate or emphasize the same series. Only selection-producing operations preserve linked-selection propagation.

line.selectXValue.note: These operations can target the same x-axis value, but filtering and highlighting have different state effects from selection.

line.zoomXRegion.note: Use line.zoomXRegion for line x-domain updates; the generic widget domain operation has been removed from the public tool surface.

parallelCoordinates.selectCohort.note: A generic selection can represent the same multi-rule cohort. Range filters approximate the effect for a single dimension but do not preserve selection propagation.

sankey.focusFlow.note: These operations can focus related flow structure, but node/path highlighting is narrower and does not necessarily create the same active selection.

scatter.brushRegion.note: scatter.brushRegion and scatter.selectRegion share the same region-selection implementation and parameters; their selection ids differ.

scatter.selectRegion.note: scatter.selectRegion and scatter.brushRegion share the same region-selection implementation and parameters; their selection ids differ.

perception.compareGroups.note: Grouped summaries or visible rows can provide the same comparison evidence when the agent performs the comparison itself.

perception.computeCorrelation.note: Visible rows permit manual correlation calculation, but inspectVisibleRows does not compute the coefficient itself.

perception.detectAnomalies.note: All identify unusual observations, but their statistical definitions and parameter names differ.

perception.findBottleneck.note: Conversion rates or raw flow summaries can be used to derive a bottleneck, but they do not directly return the same ranked result.

perception.findOutliers.note: All identify unusual observations, but their statistical definitions and parameter names differ.

perception.summarizeSelection.note: These can expose the selected subset or its evidence when queryScope resolves to the active selection.

perception.summarizeVisible.note: The alternatives can provide similar aggregate or row evidence when their scope and requested fields cover the ground-truth summary.
